Physical.name: Burning Chop
Physical.description: Fire attacks enemies in front with 167 Power added to P. Atk., causes burns, and makes them consume 43 HP every second. Cannot be used when a bow/crossbow is equipped. Over-hit. Critical.

Inflicts physical damage around enemy. Power: 1895.
Applies to enemy:
Burns 50 HP every second.
Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Burns 60 HP every sec.

Magical.name: Ritual of Life
Magical.description:

Magical.name: Curse of Pa'agrio
Magical.description: A curse that deals damage with power starting from 60 and has a chance to trigger a random debuff on each affected target from those available to the character. The assortment of debuffs depends on the level of the skill Curse of Pa'agrio, and the levels of the debuffs depend on their levels in the character.

Magical.name: Ritual of Preserve
Magical.description:
Absorbs 1200 damage.
All Skills Hit Time -15%
Resistance to Mana Burn +50%.
Can be applied only to party member.
Can't be used for 30 sec after joining a party.
Effect only works while in a party with the caster.

Magical.name: Life Impact

Removes 'Chant of Life' and 'Heart of Pa'agrio'.
